scope: Version-specific representational audit, not an independent accuracy or generalization benchmark.
selection: All17existing formation encoding pairs and every stereo-distinct same-connectivity pair in the fixed69-reaction native molecular bank. No target value or MetaG error selects cases.
preliminary_exposure: Active default feature omissions and preliminary exact native-vector equalities were observed before this audit freeze; no blinded/prospective performance claim.
controls: A tetrahedral-tag inversion must change its explicit stereochemical identity while keeping the default graph arrays identical.
Changing only E/Z must preserve the default arrays.
Enabling the optional chiral atom feature must distinguish a tag-inversion control; this is a different input configuration from the audited ensemble.
A change of atomic element must alter the arrays.
Do not call loss of enantiomer distinction a thermodynamic failure in an achiral medium.
comparator_scope: Only this frozen source and its archived100-member outputs; additional condition transformations and other graph architectures may behave differently.
limitations: Incomplete stereo encodings do not define an independently authenticated stereoisomer pair.
Graph collisions alone do not establish nonzero measured energy, predictive superiority or a MetaG advantage.
Future stereochemical comparisons need a stereo-aware graph-model control.
